source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Supports optimal functional recovery, with evidence suggesting benefits from appropriately timed early mobilization and therapy initiation","B":"Carrying fairly little established relationship to how well a client ultimately ends up recovering functionally over time","C":"Applying mainly to clients who experienced a comparatively mild stroke, rather than to clients with more severe presentations","D":"Being something that should generally be postponed until the client becomes completely medically stable in every conceivable respect"}}
source_row.rationale: Early, individualized rehabilitation planning following stroke supports optimal functional recovery, with evidence suggesting benefits from appropriately timed early mobilization and therapy initiation, applicable across a range of stroke severities.
